description: Featuring a distressed red, white, and blue flag Caduceus symbol, Rothco’s Medical Symbol Long Length T-Shirt for women honors the essential lifesaving warriors of America's Healthcare System. The women’s healthcare shirt includes the Caduceus symbol on the center chest and a reverse American flag graphic on the right sleeve. Designed with a tagless printed label, a longer length style, and a lightweight cotton / polyester construction, the Caduceus shirt provides a comfortable fit and feel. Proceeds from this purchase help support healthcare workers on the front lines of the COVID-19 crisis.
